fact: GAB-IX, created in 2014, carried only about 80 Mbps of local traffic from 2019 with just ANINF and CanalBox/GVA active, and after Gabon Telecom and Airtel Gabon reconnected local traffic rose above 250 Mbps (May 2026 relaunch).
title: Gabon : Le point d'échange Internet (IXP) GAB-IX prêt à renaître de ses cendres
